---
title: "Authentication"
description: "Credentials and scopes for the Bouncr API."
---

Base URL: `https://api.bouncr.io`.

| Scope | Access |
| --- | --- |
| `scans:create` | Create scans in authorized venues. |
| `scans:update` | Include session initialization when creating a scan, or issue a new session token. |
| `scans:read` | List scans in authorized venues and retrieve a scan with its available results. |
| `packages:read` | Download `@bouncrlabs/idv` from `registry.bouncrlabs.com`. |

| Credential | Use | Sensitive |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Organization API credential | Server-side API access within its scopes. | Yes; server-only. |
| Session token | SDK access to one scan. | Scan-scoped; supplied to the client. |
| Package download credential | Organization credential scoped to `packages:read`. | Yes; build environment only. |

Scan and venue IDs are strings. Error responses may have no body.
